deviations.what: The List mode and the Select selectedKey are two-way bound to one default-model field mode (seeded MultiSelect, a valid sap.m.ListMode), reproducing the original controller's handleSelectChange/setMode behaviour without a round-trip. The Select's change attribute is dropped (the two-way binding keeps List.mode in sync client-side). structural-diff does not flag the literal mode=MultiSelect / selectedKey=MultiSelect becoming bindings.

The full /ProductCollection mock (123 rows) is inlined; the row type is restricted to the columns the StandardListItem binds (Name, ProductId, ProductPicUrl) - a column subset, not a row subset. ProductPicUrl relative asset paths are rehosted to the OpenUI5 host https://sdk.openui5.org/ per the asset-URL rule.
